quest.title: Everything Tinkering
quest.readme.title: &cREADME!
quest.readme.welcome.title: Welcome
quest.readme.welcome.description:
&6Welcome to &eEverything Tinkering&6!

&eEverything Tinkering&6 is a modpack centered around &eTinker's Construct3&7 (TiC) &6.

&c&lNote: &r&6The modpack is still in development. If any bugs occur, please report them on the &eIssues&6 page of the &eGitHub&6 repository.

&a&lGitHub repository URL: &r&ehttps://github.com/Pelemenguin/EverythingTinkering
quest.readme.translation.title: Translations
quest.readme.translation.description: &6The English translation of the modpack is provided by the &emodpack author&6 with &eAI assistance&6. &cInaccurate translations&6 or &cgrammar mistakes&6 may exist. You can report them also on &eGitHub&6.
quest.readme.main_line.title: Main Line
quest.readme.main_line.description:
&6The &eMain Line&6 is the primary questline of the modpack.

&eForging methods&6 are mainly discussed in the &eMain Line&6. For example: &ePart Builder&6, &ecasting&6, &ealloying&6 and so on.

However, the Main Line will &cNOT&6 tell you the particular way to get Tinker's materials. You need to choose &eone or more&6 lines among the three &eMaterial Lines&6, to obtain materials and then progress the Main Line.

All chapters except &ethe first chapter&6 have &ethree Material Lines&6.
quest.readme.technology_line.title: Technology Line
quest.readme.technology_line.description:
&6The &eTechnology Line&6 is a Material Line featuring &eautomation&6.

&6In the &eTechnology Line&6, you need to:

&6 - Build &evarious machines
&6 - Design &eproduction lines
&6 - &eBuild your production line&6 via these machines
&6 - Realize &eautomated production
&6 - Then build new machines and &eupgrade your production line
quest.readme.adventure_line.title: Adventure Line
quest.readme.adventure_line.description:
&6The &eAdventure Line&6 is a Material Line featuring &eexploration&6.

&6In the &eAdventure Line&6, you need to:

&6 - Explore &evarious biomes&6
&6 - Find &enatural TiC materials
&6 - Explore &ebuildings or relics&6
&6 - Look for TiC materials in &echests&6
&6 - Defeat &evarious mobs
&6 - Get TiC material from &eloot&6
quest.readme.begin.title: Begin your adventure!
quest.overview.title: &30 &bOverview
quest.overview.begin.title: Start here
quest.overview.chapter1.title: A Beginner of Tinkering
quest.overview.chapter1.description:
&e"A Beginner of Tinkering"&6 is the &efirst&6 chapter of the Main Line.

In &e"A Beginner of Tinkering"&6, we will start from &ebasic items&6 of Tinker's Construct and learn the usage of four &eTinker's Tables&6, then build the first &eTinker's tool&6 of your own.
quest.chapters.title: Main Line
quest.chapters.1.title: &31 &bA Beginner of Tinkering
quest.chapters.1.begin.title: A Beginner of Tinkering
quest.chapters.1.begin.subtitle: Simple material shaping
quest.chapters.1.patterns.title: Pattern
quest.chapters.1.patterns.description:
&6&ePatterns&6 are an essential item for all novice tinkers.

Patterns only require &eplanks&6 and &esticks&6 to craft. Cheap to make and useful to simple &ematerial shaping&6.
quest.chapters.1.part_builder.title: Part Builder
quest.chapters.1.part_builder.descriptio:
&ePart Builder&6 can let you craft basic &etool parts&6.

Part Builders require &ePatterns&6 and &eplanks&6 to craft.
quest.chapters.1.tinker_station.title: Tinker Station
quest.chapters.1.tinker_station.descript:
&eTinker Station&6 can let you combine &etool parts&6 into &eTinker's tools&6.

Tinker Stations require &ePatterns&6 and &eplanks&6 to craft.
quest.chapters.1.crafting_station.title: Crafting Station
quest.chapters.1.crafting_station.descri:
&eCrafting Stations&6 can be seen as upgraded &eCrafting Tables&6. After closing the GUI, items can be &ekept in the crafting grid&6.

Crafting Stations require &ePatterns&6 and &eCrafting Tables&6 to craft. Or directly craft from &elogs&6 and &ePatterns&6.
quest.chapters.1.part_chest.title: Part Chest
quest.chapters.1.part_chest.description:
&ePart Chest&6 can store &elarge amount&6 of extra parts.

Part Chests require &ePatterns&6, &eChests&6, &eplanks&6 and &esticks&6 to craft.

If you accidentally made some wrong parts or picked up some useless parts, you can place them in the Part Chest.
quest.chapters.1.tinkers_chest.title: Tinker's Chest
quest.chapters.1.tinkers_chest.descripti:
&eTinker's Chest&6 can store &eany items&6. It has &e64&6 slots, but each slot can only store &e16&6 items. It can be &edyed using dyes&6. 

Part Chests require &ePatterns&6, &eChests&6, &eplanks&6 and &eLapis Lazuli&6 to craft.
quest.chapters.1.tutorial_parts.title: Tool Parts
quest.chapters.1.tutorial_parts.descript:
&eTool parts&6 can be combined into &eTinker's tools&6. Simple tool parts can be crafted in the &ePart Builder&6.

To make a &ePickaxe&6 for instance, we need to make:

&6 - A &ePick Head

&6 - A &eTool Handle

&6 - A &eTool Binding

&6As shown in the image above, &ePatterns&6 should be placed in the &eleftmost&6 slot in the Part Builder, while the &ematerial to be used&6 are placed to the right of the Patterns. After choosing &ethe part to craft&6 in the middle, you can get the corresponding part.

Let's try to make all three parts of a &ePickaxe&6 by yourself!

&c&lNote: &r&6When crafting parts, Patterns are &cCONSUMED&6. Prepare &emore&6 patterns to craft more parts!
quest.chapters.1.part_builder_uncraftabl:
&6Somtimes, you may try to shape some materials &etoo hard&6 to shape, &eiron&6 or other metal for instance.

&6These materials &cCANNOT&6 be crafted in the Part Builder. This requires better &eforging methods&6 provided in future chapters.

&c&lNote: &r&eCopper&6 is still craftable in the Part Builder, which is both cheap and effective for mining.
quest.chapters.1.part_switching.title: Change Tool Parts
quest.chapters.1.part_switching.descript:
&6Now you have &ebetter parts&6, and may want to apply them to your tools.

But rebuilding the entire tool &ecosts much&6. Thus, you can use &eTinker Station&6 for &epart swapping&6, as shown below:
quest.chapters.1.tutorial_tools.title: Your First Tool
quest.chapters.1.tutorial_tools.descript: &6After preparing all parts needed, you can combine them into a tool at a &eTinker Station&6. The interface of the Tinker Station is shown below:

&6However, the default view is not helpful for us to know how to build the tool. Click the button with a &ePickaxe&6 icon on the left, then you can see &e3 slots&6 with icons of tool parts. Put &ecorresponding tool part&6 into the slots to build your own tool.
quest.chapters.1.repair_kits.title: Repair Kits
quest.chapters.1.repair_kits.description: &6You can repair your tool at a &eTinker Station&6 using the material of your tool's head part.
&6However, &eRepair Kits&6 seem to be a more convenient choice, as they can directly repair tools in the &ecrafting grid&6. You can make Repair Kits at a &ePart Builder&6 just like common tool parts.
quest.chapters.1.other_tools.title: Other tools
quest.chapters.1.other_tools.description: &6Try to make some other tools! They may require &edifferent types of parts&6. You can check the requirements in the &eTinker Station&6.
quest.chapters.1.target_dummy.title: Target Dummy
quest.chapters.1.target_dummy.descriptio: &6Ever wondered how many damage is your tool dealing? Make a &eTarget Dummy&6 to test that!
quest.chapters.1.more_materials.title: More Materials
quest.chapters.1.more_materials.descript:
&6Tools can made of not only wood, but &eother materials&6 as well.

Maybe you can try to use &eRock&e and &eCopper&6 to make tools?

&e"Knowledge is power."&6 You can get inspirations from the books provided, such as &e"Materials And You"&6.
quest.chapters.1.distinct_materials.desc: &6You can use &edifferent&6 materials in differnt parts of the tool.
quest.chapters.1.distinct_materials.task: Any tool with all parts' materials different
quest.chapters.1.travelers_set.title: Traveler's Armor
quest.chapters.1.travelers_set.descripti:
&ePlate Armor&6 specializes in &eprotection&6, but require better forging method.

&eTraveler's Armor&6 seems to be a good starter armor for beginners. These armor can provide &ea little protection&6 (about &e75%&6 of Plate Armor), but better than nothing.
quest.chapters.1.modifiers.title: Modifiers
quest.chapters.1.modifiers.description.1:
&eModifiers&6 may &eenhance your tool&6. You can apply modifiers at a &eTinker Station&6.

Let's apply a &eSwiftstrike&6 modifier as an example.

You can view recipes of modifiers in the &eJEI&6.
quest.chapters.1.modifiers.description.2:
&6As the image shown above, among the four slots on the left side of the arrow, your tool should be placed in the &erightmost&6 slot. Then the items required for the modifier should be placed in the &eleft 3 slots&6.

In this case, you need &e18 Blocks of Amethyst&6 or &e72 Amethyst Shards&6.
quest.chapters.1.more_modifiers.title: More modifiers
quest.chapters.1.more_modifiers.descript:
&6Maybe you can try &emore modifiers&6. For example, &eSpeedy&6, &eHaste&6 or &eSharpness&6.

Applying &ethe same modifier recipe&6 on &edifferent tool types&6, the modifier applied &emay differs&6. Using &eRedstone&6 as modifier item, &eHaste&6 is applied on &ePixkaxes&6 or other tools, while &eSpeedy&6 is applied on &eLeggings&6.
quest.chapters.1.more_modifiers.task.spe: Any tool with Speedy modifier or Haste modifier
quest.chapters.1.ready.title: I'm Ready
quest.chapters.1.ready.description.1:
&6Explore the &etinkering system&6 by yourself.

When you are ready for the coming &eBoss challenge&6, click the checkmark above.
quest.chapters.1.ready.description.2:
&aHow do I know whether I'm ready or not?

&6 - Attack damage reach &e8 points&6 per hit or above
&6 - Have a full set of &eTraveler's Armor&6
&6 - Obtain at least &e20%%&6 movement speed boost

Or you can ignore these criteria if you are skilled enough.
quest.chapters.1.frozen_terracube_core.d:
&6Use &efreezing damage&6 to kill a &elarge Terracube&6 to obtain a &eFrozen Terracube Core&6.

When you're ready, use the Frozen Terracube Core in &ecold biomes&6 to summon the &eIcy Terracube&6.
quest.technology_chapters.title: Technology Line
quest.technology_chapters.1.title: &2T1 &aFundamentals of Mechanics
quest.technology_chapters.1.andesite_all: &6Make some &eAndesite Alloy&6 by crafting from &eAndesite&6 and &eIron Nuggets&6, which is the fundamental for developing &eCreate&6.
quest.technology_chapters.1.mechanical_b: &eMechanical Belt&6 can transport items when placed flat, serving as an important early-game &elogistics tool&6.
quest.technology_chapters.1.andesitize.d: &6The &eAndesitize&6 modifier allows you to &etransform Stone into Andesite&6. This enables &eautomated Andesite production&6, simply have a &eDeployer&6 right-click Stone for you.
quest.technology_chapters.1.basic_mechan:
&6Craft a &eBasic Mechanism&6 from &eAndesite Alloy&6 in a &ePart Builder&6.

The Basic Mechanism is used to create a series of machines with &eAndesite Casing&6 as their housing. These machines facilitate the &eautomation&6 of Basic Mechanism production.
quest.technology_chapters.1.andesite_cas:
&6The &eAndesite Casing&6 forms the housing for most basic machines.

To craft one, &einteract with a placed Stripped Log while holding Andesite Alloy&6.
quest.technology_chapters.1.mechanical_p: &6The &eMechanical Press&6 can &ecompress items&6, such as pressing metal ingots into &esheets&6.
quest.technology_chapters.1.mechanical_m: &eMechanical Mixer&6 can &emix items together&6 or process many &eshapeless recipes&6.
&eEncased Fan&6 can &ecreate airstreams&6, but is more commonly used for &eBulk Washing&6, &eBulk Blasting&6, &eBulk Smoking&6, or &eBulk Haunting&6 (see Ponder interface for details).
quest.technology_chapters.1.deployer.des:
&6The &eDeployer&6 can &emimic a player using an item&6. Sometimes, it can perform actions &eunavailable to players&6, as certain recipes &emust be completed by a Deployer&6.

&e"What are you pointing at? Huh? What are you pointing at?"
quest.technology_chapters.1.mechanical_d:
&6The &eMechanical Saw&6 can &eautomatically mine blocks&6, which is helpful to the automation of &eAndesite&6. 

You can use &eKinetic Contraptions to squeeze&6 blocks and collect them. Thus, this quest is optional.
quest.technology_chapters.1.mechanical_s: &6The &eMechanical Saw&6 can &ebreak wooden blocks&6 and chop down &ean entire tree&6, and can also process &emechanical cutting&6 recipes.
quest.technology_chapters.1.millstone.de: &eMillstone&6 can &egrind items&6 and serves as an early-game alternative to the &eCrushing Wheel&6.
quest.technology_chapters.1.mechanical_b: &eMechanical Bearing&6 can &emake your contraptions rotate&6. Check the &ePonder&6 interface for detailed usage, and check other machines' Ponder interfaces to see their functions in rotational structures.
quest.technology_chapters.1.ready.title: Begin Automating
quest.technology_chapters.1.ready.descri:
&6Start automating &eBasic Mechanisms&6!

&c&lNote:&r&6 All automation images are &efor demonstration only&6. They are for reference but &edo not specify exact build methods&6. These diagrams are &enot optimal solutions&6; you can design more efficient or aesthetically pleasing contraptions.
quest.technology_chapters.1.log_automati:
&eLogs&6 are raw materials for crafting &epatterns&6.

The image below is an automation example, using a &eDeployer&6 to place saplings and a &eMechanical Saw&6 to collect logs. A &eMechanical Bearing&6 below the structure makes it rotate.
quest.technology_chapters.1.cobblestone_:
&eCobblestone&6 can be used to automate &eIron Nuggets&6.

The diagram below is an automation example, where a &eMechanical Drill&6 faces the position where Cobblestones are generated to mine it, with a &eMechanical Belt&6 directly below for collection.
quest.technology_chapters.1.andesite_aut:
&eAndesite&6 is essential for crafting &eAndesite Alloy&6.

The diagram below is an automation example, where a &eDeployer&6 holding a tool with the &eAndesitize&6 modifier first turns stone into andesite, then a &eMechanical Drill&6 collects it.

For better visibility, the image shows a cross-section of the contraption; the actual build is approximately hemispherical.
quest.technology_chapters.1.pattern_auto:
&6Use a &eMechanical Saw&6 to cut a &elog&6 &ethree times&6 to obtain a &ePattern&6.

&c&lNote:&r&6 The raw material may be cut into &edifferent items&6, so you need to mark the desired product in the &eRecipe Filter&6.
quest.technology_chapters.1.gravel_autom:
&6Crush &ecobblestone&6 to obtain &eGravel&6.

In Chapter 1, the &eMillstone&6 is the only machine for crushing items. You can also replace Millstones with the &eCrushing Wheels&6 after getting them in later chapters.
quest.technology_chapters.1.iron_nugget_:
&6Wash &eGravel&6 with an &eEncased Fan&6 to obtain a small amount of &eIron Nuggets&6.

&6Washing gravel produces a large amount of &eFlint&6, which you need to remove by some method, such as the &eBrass Funnel&6, &eBrass Tunnel&6, etc. introduced in later chapters.

&c&lNote:&r&6 Gravel takes &esome time&6 to be washed into Iron Nuggets. You need to ensure the Mechanical Belt's speed is &eslow enough&6 to allow all Gravel to be processed.
quest.technology_chapters.1.andesite_all: &6Mix &eAndesite&6 and &eIron Nuggets&6 using a &eMechanical Mixer&6 to obtain &eAndesite Alloy&6.
quest.technology_chapters.1.basic_mechan: &6Apply &ethree Andesite Alloys&6 on a &ePattern&6 to craft a &eBasic Mechanism&6.
quest.technology_chapters.1.materials.an: Tool made of &eAndesite Alloy&6 can &eattack targets in a straight line&6.
